This pertains to a Path Traversal vulnerability – CVSS 4.0 High and an Authentication Bypass vulnerability – CVSS 4.0 Critical.

Cleo strongly advises all customers to immediately patch their product(s) to version 5.8.1.15 or 6.0.0.1 to address the vulnerability.
